discordPostHtml:
Adds the pre-0.96 Brilliant back into the game. Does not remove the current version.
This ship has a single hangar bay, and loses the Plasma Burn ship system, which is replaced with Active Flares.

Forum Thread: https://fractalsoftworks.com/forum/index.php?topic=30831.0
aiDescription: Adds the previous iteration of a ship without overriding the current version. It adds a fighter bay and changes the system from Plasma Burn to Active Flares.
